ABOUT_SCREEN.WELCOME_TEXT: Your ultimate guide to exploring the breathtaking beauty and cultural richness of the Kokan region.
ABOUT_SCREEN.DISCOVER_TEXT1: The Kokan coast, stretching along the western shores of India, is a treasure trove of natural wonders, historical landmarks, and vibrant culture. From pristine beaches and lush green landscapes to ancient temples and bustling local markets, Kokan has something for every traveler.
ABOUT_SCREEN.DISCOVER_TEXT2: With Tourkokan, you can explore popular destinations like Devgad Beach, Malvan, Ratnagiri, and many more hidden gems waiting to be discovered.
ABOUT_SCREEN.VISION_TEXT: To showcase the sustainable and authentic real Kokan lifestyle while empowering local communities. We believe in growing local businesses, preserving our cultural heritage, and providing tourists with structured, accessible resources that make exploring Kokan effortless and memorable.
ABOUT_SCREEN.MISSION_TEXT: To promote all local businesses—from small-scale vendors to established enterprises—through our advertising platform, product listings, and tourism services. We encourage authentic Kokan lifestyle experiences while helping local tourism businesses thrive and grow sustainably.
ABOUT_SCREEN.WHY_SUB: Tourkokan stands out for its comprehensive approach to travel guidance and commitment to authentic experiences.
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_1: Detailed information about tourist spots with real-time updates
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_2: Genuine user reviews from fellow Kokan explorers
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_3: Interactive maps with offline access for seamless navigation
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_4: Live MSRTC bus schedules and timetables
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_5: Support local businesses through our listings and partnerships
ABOUT_SCREEN.FEAT_6: Sustainable tourism practices that preserve Kokan's beauty
ABOUT_SCREEN.COMMITMENT_TEXT1: We are dedicated to enhancing your travel experience with reliable and up-to-date information. Our team continuously works to expand our database with new destinations, updated bus timetables, and the latest events in Kokan.
ABOUT_SCREEN.COMMITMENT_TEXT2: Whether you're a Kokan lover returning home, a first-time visitor eager to explore, or someone seeking authentic cultural immersion—Tourkokan ensures you have the best resources at your fingertips.
ABOUT_SCREEN.CTA_TEXT: Be part of our community of explorers. Share your experiences, support local businesses, and help preserve the authentic Kokan lifestyle for generations to come.
ABOUT_SCREEN.WRITE_TEXT: We love hearing from our users! Whether you have questions, need assistance, or want to share your travel stories, reach out to us.
ABOUT_SCREEN.EMPOWERING: Empowering local businesses • Preserving authentic culture
ABOUT_SCREEN.SHARE_MSG: Explore the beautiful Kokan region with Tourkokan! 🏖️ Download the app and start your journey.
